name: F5, Inc.
moat_justification: Moderate-strong, not wide. F5 is the incumbent in application delivery controllers (BIG-IP) sitting in mission-critical traffic paths, with high switching costs, a Leader position in WAAP, and one of only two Market Shaper spots in Gartner's Sept 2026 AI Application Security quadrant. Recurring revenue is real (services ~46% of Q3 FY26 revenue; subscriptions 90% of software revenue) and gross margins above 82% plus OE positive 5 of the last 5 years show pricing power held through a cycle. But the core is mature — 5-yr revenue CAGR is only 5.61% and Q3 FY26 software revenue grew just 7% — and hyperscalers bundle competing delivery/security, Cloudflare and 40+ AI-security vendors contest the growth layer, and the secular shift from on-prem ADC to cloud/SaaS delivery erodes the installed-base advantage over time. That is a 6, not a 7-8.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 12 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: High-quality app-delivery/security incumbent, moat 6/10 — but at $462.90 it does not come close to the 15% hurdle: weighted IRR 6.82%, weighted IV@15% $147.14; it would need to fall to roughly $147.14 to clear 15%.
moat_for: BIG-IP installed base in mission-critical traffic paths — high switching costs
Leader in application delivery / WAAP; one of only two Gartner Market Shapers in AI application security (Sept 2026)
Recurring base: services ~46% of Q3 FY26 revenue, subscriptions 90% of software revenue
Gross margins above 82% and owner's earnings positive 5 of the last 5 years — pricing power held through a cycle
Hybrid multicloud, on-prem and air-gapped reach that hyperscaler-native tools do not match
moat_against: Hyperscaler-bundled load balancing and security (AWS / Azure / Google) plus Cloudflare at the edge
Secular shift from on-prem ADC hardware toward cloud / SaaS delivery
Mature core: 5-yr revenue CAGR 5.61%, Q3 FY26 software revenue only +7% YoY
40+ vendors contesting AI application security — the growth-layer lead must be re-earned
Systems / component-cost cyclicality (FY2022 operating cash flow dipped to $442,631,000)
